mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: The following are mandatory requirements. Proposals not clearly meeting these mandatory requirements will be considered non-compliant and will not be evaluated, and therefore will be rejected from the evaluation process.
value: Certification document - Section C Item 9 "Proposal Certification Document" must be completed in full and signed by the Proponent.
Any proposals not including this information will not be considered for evaluation.

Accessibility: System that prioritizes ease of use and straightforward navigation, Streamlined menu system, Intuitive navigation, Ability to customize system menus and content for the institution, Meets the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
Mobile Learning: Allowing learners to access courses at any time and from any location using their mobile devices, Providing mobile access in a streamlined and simplified manner

Integrations: Ability to integrate with existing College systems, Ellucian Banner (state whether Ellucian ILP will be necessary, or whether there would be a custom developed integration methodology available as an alternative), Allowing for external integrations which will support student experience and system functionality, Ease of integration for external applications or other tools, Automated course enrolment and permission provisioning for students and instructors, Support for Application Programming Interface (APIs)

Security: Maintaining data security standards to safeguard sensitive learning materials and learner information, Safeguards against data breaches, Ability to adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA), Proponents must be able to provide a HECVAT cybersecurity & privacy assessment, SAML based Single Sign-On (SSO) integration, State whether the platform supports "local" Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) support or whether MFA is dependent on the above SSO integration

Data Migration (as applicable): Ensuring data migration capabilities for importing and exporting content to ensure a seamless transition, Including the ability to migrate preexisting LMS data into the system in a streamlined manner

Cloud-Based System: Providing an LMS in a cloud-based, rather than on-premise, platform, Preference will be given to a Canadian host location, Describe your approach to server resourcing ensuring adequate scaling to deal with periods of heavy load (exam week), the approach you use to resolve slow system responsiveness

Data Analytics: Providing robust data analytics on courses, programs and learners; including associated reporting features, Including enrollment trends, learner success metrics, etc., Student online activity in a course/program easily available to Instructors in real time

Customer Support: Ability for the institution to secure support for broader system issues, Provision of robust transitional training support to ensure our college support team consistently has access to responsive technical support
Implementation: Providing robust implementation support for any system transition, Including transition of content, training, etc.
